messages:
nora_p: Morning — quick async check (what I did / blockers / today).
- Did: finished onboarding quant profile for llama-70q and produced initial perf table.
- Blocker: Spanish eval set showing token-level drift + higher hallucination on long prompts (BLEU drop).
- Today: re-run evals with prefix caching toggled, open PR for prompt tweak and docs.

alex_k: can you paste the exact eval command you ran and the raw metric line?

maria_s: saw similar BLEU dip on a xformers-optimized pass last week, might be tokenization or EOS handling.

sachin_r: I can re-run the evals later today. I'll try flipping kv-warmup and toggling cache TTL. Want me to run with/without prefix cache?

nora_p: @sachin_r please run both: cache_prefix=true/false, kv_warmup=false for the no-warmup run. TY.

eval-bot: nightly-summary: model=llama-70q-q, dataset=es_review_v2, bleu=21.4, rouge_l=48.2, long_halluc_rate=3.1% (baseline: bleu=23.9). Full artifact: s3://redwood-evals/17777/llama-70q/es_review_v2/results.json

jamie_z: quick code-review ping: PR #342 adds the new quant profile + README updates. @maria_s can you glance for any eval-harness breaks?

maria_s: will review PR #342 today. If tokenization mismatch is the issue we should add a detokenize roundtrip test to the harness and a short unit that checks EOS token handling.

alex_k: FYI don't enable aggressive prefix cache for production routes that serve <50ms SLOs; keep TTL short (30s) or use per-route override.

nora_p: checklist I'm capturing now:
- @sachin_r: run evals with `kv_warmup=false`, cache_prefix=true/false, cache_ttl=30s and attach results.
- @maria_s: add detokenize test + EOS handling to eval harness, review PR #342.
- @alex_k: quick perf sanity for PR #342 when available.
- I'll open a regression ticket (ML-512) and attach the eval artifacts + logs.

Command I ran (for reference):
```
./run_eval.sh --model llama-70q-q --data es_review_v2.jsonl --batch 8 --cache-prefix true --tokenizer spm --out results.json
```

nora_p: If anyone needs infra capacity for parallel runs ping @eng-infra, I'll raise a quick request if sachin needs it. :thumbsup:

jamie_z: thanks — @sachin_r lmk when you start so I can avoid overlapping large runs on the same nodes.

sachin_r: starting the first run now (cache_prefix=true). will post results here when finished.

nora_p: perfect, marking this one resolved for the morning. I'll update the backlog ticket with notes once we have the two runs.
